title: Introducing Orbital Skybender
description:
With new technology comes new possibilities. In this video we discover the exceptional capabilities of wind charge technology and use it to design a new kind of orbital cannon. One that can be linked directly to the player and enable them to harness power of TnT and have it flow through them, into a Minecraft world with the power of redstone.
